rejected.title: Konoha Hidden Leaf Village
rejected.author: Tigerar1
rejected.reason: Downloaded and rendered from four angles. It is a 193 x 197 m tabletop diorama with a painted sky dome and flat display base; it is not a closed playable environment and mounting it would read as a toy village. Preserved in artifacts/asset-fetch, not shipped.

rightsScope: The CC BY licences cover the uploaders' models; they do not grant rights to the Naruto franchise or its designs. Treat this as local prototype art and confirm distribution permission separately.
